title: CVX content schema (v1)
description: Canonical definitions for every file CVX reads from cv-content/. Per-file schemas (personal.schema.json, config.schema.json, ...) reference the $defs here. Content files never break within a schema major version.

bulletItem.description: A bullet line. Either a plain string, or an object when part of the line should be a hyperlink: { text, link: { href, label }, suffix }. Rendered as: text + link.label (clickable) + suffix.

linkEntry.description: A labelled hyperlink used by personal.links.

label.description: Visible link text, e.g. "Portfolio" or "Blog". Optional — falls back to the URL if omitted.

personal.title: personal.yaml
personal.description: Identity and contact details. Required in practice: 'name' drives the output filename and PDF metadata. (The default two-column layout also needs summary.yaml and experience.yaml present.)

name.description: Full name. Required — also derives the PDF filename (lowercased, spaces to hyphens).

title.description: Professional headline, e.g. "Senior Engineer". Also used for PDF metadata and ATS keyword derivation.

company.description: Current employer, shown under the title.

phoneHref.description: Optional link target for the phone row, e.g. "tel:+15550100".

email.description: Email address; rendered as a mailto: link automatically.

linkedinHref.description: Full LinkedIn URL used as the link target.

facebook.description: Facebook display text. Shown only in the two-column sidebar, not in the ATS header.

facebookHref.description: Full Facebook URL used as the link target.

location.description: City / country line. Plain text, no link.

links.description: Extra labelled links beyond the built-in linkedin/facebook rows — portfolio, blog, GitHub, personal site, etc. Each item is { label, href }.

summary.title: summary.yaml
summary.description: Professional summary as a list of bullet lines. Items may be plain strings or the object form with an inline hyperlink.

title.description: Role title held during this step. Also feeds ATS keyword derivation.

period.description: Free-text date range for this step, e.g. "2019 – 2021".

role.description: Job title. Required. Also feeds ATS keyword derivation.

location.description: Where the role was based. Shown in the designed layout only, not in the ATS variant.

progression.description: Promotions / role changes within the same company, most recent first.

bullets.description: Achievement bullet points. Items may be plain strings or the object form with an inline hyperlink.

experience.title: experience.yaml
experience.description: Work history as a list of entries, most recent first.

degree.description: Qualification name, e.g. "BSc Computer Science". Required.

period.description: Free-text date range or year. Omit to hide the date line.

education.title: education.yaml
education.description: Education as a list of entries, most recent first.

name.description: Certification name, e.g. "LFD259: Kubernetes for Developers". Required. Also feeds ATS keyword derivation.

year.description: Free-text year or date earned. Omit to hide the date line.

certifications.title: certifications.yaml
certifications.description: Professional certifications as a list of entries, most recent first. Kept distinct from achievements.yaml (awards and recognitions).

venue.description: Where it appeared — journal, conference, publisher, or site.

year.description: Free-text year or date. Omit to hide the date line.

publications.title: publications.yaml
publications.description: Publications and written work as a list of entries, most recent first.

proficiency.description: Free-text proficiency, e.g. "Native", "Professional", "Conversational". Omit to show just the language.

languages.title: languages.yaml
languages.description: Languages spoken as a list of entries.

competencies.title: competencies.yaml
competencies.description: Core skills as a flat list of short strings. Rendered as pills in the designed layout; also feeds ATS keyword derivation.

year.description: Bold headline of the achievement — often a year or award name, but any short string works.

text.description: Attribution / detail line rendered under the headline.

achievements.title: achievements.yaml
achievements.description: Awards and recognitions as a list of entries.

referees.title: referees.yaml
referees.description: References as a list of entries. An empty list ([]) prints "References available upon request." in the two-column layout and omits the section in the ATS variant.

keywordGroup.description: Named group of keywords. Group names are for your organisation only — they are flattened and discarded in the PDF metadata.

keywords.title: keywords.yaml
keywords.description: Optional ATS keywords embedded in PDF metadata (never printed). Accepts a flat list of strings, a map of named groups, a mixed list of strings and group maps, or a single string. Merged with auto-derived keywords (competencies, titles) unless disabled in config.

config.title: config.yaml
config.description: Build configuration: theme, layout, first-page pagination, and ATS keyword behaviour.

schemaVersion.description: Content schema major version. Content files never break within a major.

theme.description: Colour theme. One of the built-in themes; an unknown value fails the build.

layout.description: Layout name, matching a file in cv-content/layouts/ (built-ins: "two-column", "single-column"). An unknown value warns and falls back to the built-in default.

page1ExperienceCount.description: Exact number of experience entries on page 1 — entry N+1 starts page 2. If the forced count does not fit, validate/build warn and the overflow spills onto extra physical pages (nothing is clipped; the CV just gains unplanned pages). Omit for automatic page packing (never overflows).

page1SplitBullets.description: Split the last page-1 experience entry after this many bullets, continuing overleaf. Omit to keep entries whole.

enabled.description: Write the Keywords field into PDF metadata.

autoDerive.description: Merge keywords derived from competencies and role titles.

max.description: Cap the number of keywords written. Omit for no cap.

layoutSlot.description: One slot in a page region: a section key string (identity-photo, identity-compact, contact, summary, experience, education, competencies, achievements, referees, header-ats, experience:continued, spacer:N), or an object form — { spacer: N } or { <section>: { continued: true } }.

layoutPage.description: Slots for one page kind. The two columns are read differently: the `main` lists ARE per-page-kind (first.main renders on page 1, last.main on the final page, continuation.main in between), while the `sidebar` lists across first/continuation/last are concatenated into ONE ordered flow that the engine measures and paginates itself — so listing a section under `last` sets its position in the sidebar order, not the page it renders on. identity-photo/identity-compact are the exception: they are injected at the top of every page's sidebar rather than packed.

sidebar.description: Slots in the sidebar column (two-column template only). Part of the single ordered sidebar flow — see this object's description: you choose the order, the engine measures the page placement.

main.description: Slots in the main column, for this page kind specifically.

layout.title: layouts/*.yaml
layout.description: A layout file: which template to use and which sections appear where on each page kind.

template.description: Page template the layout builds on.

geometry.description: Reserved. Currently ignored — page geometry comes from the theme. Kept so existing files with a geometry block stay valid.

first.description: Flat form: equivalent to pages.first when the pages: wrapper is omitted.

continuation.description: Flat form: equivalent to pages.continuation when the pages: wrapper is omitted.

last.description: Flat form: equivalent to pages.last when the pages: wrapper is omitted.
